name: io.github.relatasql/relatasql-mcp
description: Official MCP server for RelataSQL - inspect and query databases with JIT access, read-only enforcement, sandboxing and governed writes.

environmentVariables.name: RELATASQL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your RelataSQL API key (Settings -> API Keys, starts with relata_live_).

environmentVariables.name: RELATASQL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: RelataSQL API base URL. Defaults to the official cloud API (https://api.relatasql.com).
